name: Glaive Spellhardt
desc:
Glaive is a male Lightborn located in the Upper Hall/Second Floor of [The Floating Keep](location:the_floating_keep). He sells various Hallowtide exclusive items for Joy, though they are usually combat-related.

His stock consists of:

**2025:**

With 2025 Hallowtide, came with 3 newly-added Hallowtide-exclusive weapons on top of the weapons from last years. Two from the first week, and one on the second week, on the October 31st, 2025 and November 8th, 2025

1.  Master Schematic \[20 Joy\] - Gives you a random Master outfit schematic.
2.  Skyreap Blade (Greataxe) \[100 Joy\]
3.  Hallowscleave (Sword) \[100 Joy\]
4.  Skull Piercer (Rapier) \[100 Joy\]
5.  Putrid Edenstaff (Greathammer) \[100 Joy\]
6.  Bloodtide Trident (Spear) \[100 Joy\]
7.  Drakemaw Gauntlets (Fist) \[100 Joy\]
8.  Gourdguard (Shield) \[80 Joy\]
9.  Wretched Mawblades (Greatsword) \[100 Joy\]
10.  Death's Reverie (Twinblade) \[100 Joy\]
11.  Spectral Grasp (Dagger) \[100 Joy\]
12.  Smouldering Hallow (Greatcannon) \[100 Joy\]
13.  Moppet (Dagger) \[100 Joy\]
14.  The Weaving Web (Spear) \[100 Joy\]
15.  Harrowing Enchant Stone \[150 Joy\]
16.  Pumpkin Pitch (Mantra) \[300 Joy\]

With 2022 Hallowtide, came with 3 Hallowtide-exclusive weapons, and a random master outfit schematic. All of the weapons used to cost 60 Joy, but were increased to 70 a few minutes later on the November 7th, 2022 update.
